statement: For every root satisfying the preconditions, increasing_bst(root) returns a result r (it does not fail) and r = chain(inorder(root)), where chain([]) = Null and, for n >= 1 and a sequence s = [s0, s1, ..., s_{n-1}], chain(s) = Node(s0, Null, chain([s1, ..., s_{n-1}])). Equivalently, if n = len(inorder(root)), then r has exactly n nodes and for every k with 0 <= k < n, the k-th node on the right spine from the root (0-indexed) has value inorder(root)[k], left child Null, and right child equal to the (k+1)-th spine node when k < n-1 and Null when k = n-1.
preconditions: root is a Tree with 1 <= nodes(root) <= 100, every value stored in root lies in the interval [0,1000], and root is a binary search tree, formalized as: inorder(root) is nondecreasing (for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(inorder(root)), inorder(root)[i] <= inorder(root)[j]). Here nodes(Null)=0 and nodes(Node(v,L,R))=1+nodes(L)+nodes(R); inorder(Null)=[] and inorder(Node(v,L,R))=inorder(L) ++ [v] ++ inorder(R), with ++ denoting sequence concatenation and sequences 0-indexed.
